hero.titolo: Report what's happening in your neighborhood.
hero.sottotitolo: Crime collects public safety reports on a shared map. Each report expires on its own once it's no longer useful.

fase1.titolo: Open the map and pick a spot
fase1.descrizione: Mark where the event happened and choose the most fitting category.

fase2.titolo: The report stays visible until it expires
fase2.descrizione: Each category has a validity period: once it's over, the report disappears on its own.

fase3.descrizione: Suspicious reports can be flagged and are reviewed by the platform's moderators.

footer.tagline: Crime — public safety reports maintained by the community.

guida.sottotitolo: Instructions for using Crime, plus information on categories, duration and moderation.
guida.categorieNonDisponibili: Categories are not available right now.

1.descrizione: Nuisance and quiet: noise, litter, lighting, illegal parking.

2.descrizione: Against property and suspicious situations: thefts, vandalism, drug dealing, scams.

3.descrizione: Against people: violence, threats, robberies, fires.

aCosaServe.r: A shared map of public-safety reports. Anyone can browse what has been reported around them; registered users can add reports. Every report expires automatically.

emergenze.r: No. Crime does not replace emergency services and reports are not monitored in real time. If you are in danger, call 112: the “Emergency” button on the map starts the call after a confirmation.

simboli.d: How do I read the markers?
simboli.r: Each marker shows the category icon. Colour indicates severity: red is high, orange is medium, grey (smaller) is low. A pulsing ring marks a high-severity report created less than an hour ago. Tap a marker to open its details.

alone.d: What is the halo around markers?
alone.r: It means the position is approximate (about 100 metres): the event may have moved after it was reported. It appears when zoomed in.

listaRaggio.r: “List” shows active reports around you, nearest first. You can choose the radius (500 m to 10 km) and filter by severity and category.

posizione.r: To centre the map and sort the list by distance. If you refuse, the map is still usable, starting from a default area.

tema.d: How do I change theme and language?
tema.r: In your profile’s Preferences you choose language, app theme and map theme (which can stay light or dark regardless of the app). On a computer, language and theme are also in the gear at the top.

come.d: How do I make a report?
come.r: Tap “Report”, place the pin on the exact spot and confirm. Then choose the category, describe what you saw and publish.

account.r: Not to browse the map and list. To publish and to answer “Is it still happening?” you need a free account.

anonima.r: Yes. With “Publish anonymously” your name is not shown to other users, but the report stays linked to your account for moderation. On other reports, registered users see the first name and the initial of the surname (e.g. “Mario R.”), never the email.

scrivere.d: What can I write in the description?
scrivere.r: Describe what is happening and where, not who is involved. Personal data (phone numbers, emails, plates), links, insults and references to people’s origin or religion are blocked before publishing: we tell you what to fix. Text written all in capitals or with repetitions is published but checked by an administrator.

problema.d: What if a report is false or offensive?
problema.r: In the report details tap “Report a problem” and choose the reason. You can do it once per report, not on your own. An administrator reviews it and decides whether to remove it.

rimuovere.d: Can I edit or remove a report?
rimuovere.r: You can remove it from your profile. It cannot be edited: if you made a mistake, remove it and create a new one.

scadenza.d: How long does a report stay visible?
scadenza.r: It depends on the category, from 4 hours to 3 days (shown in the category list). Then it becomes “concluded” and disappears from the map; it stays in the author’s profile.

voto.d: What do Yes and No do in “Is it still happening?”
voto.r: A Yes extends the expiry (once per category duration) and resets earlier No answers. Three No answers from different users close the report. The author’s No closes it immediately, after confirmation; only an administrator can reopen it.

cambiareVoto.r: Yes. In the details you can see the answer you already gave, highlighted.

quali.r: The active categories, grouped by severity. The list is updated in real time and shows how long each report stays visible.

registrazione.r: From “Sign in” choose “Sign up” and enter first name, last name, email and password.

profilo.d: What can I do in my profile?
profilo.r: Edit your name, change your password, manage your reports and set your preferences (language and themes).

fiducia.d: What are verified identity and trust score?
fiducia.r: Verified identity is shown in your profile. The trust score is an internal value and does not limit use of the app.

dati.r: Category, description, position and time of the report and, only for registered users and if not anonymous, the first name and initial of the surname. Emails and passwords are never shown.

storico.d: How long is my data kept?
storico.r: While the report is active and for 12 months after it closes. It is then anonymised: author, description and votes are removed and the position is rounded to about 100 m. Only category, area and dates are kept, for statistics, and the report no longer appears in your profile.

moderazione.r: Administrators, who review reports with reported problems and can remove or reactivate them. When problem reports reach a threshold, the report is suspended pending review; people whose problem reports turn out to be unfounded count less the next time, and those who publish removed content lose reliability. Every action is recorded.
